text: Break the Sequence graphic-novel validation (3 keyframes, 9 LTX clips): ink survives LTX when the motion line pins the palette; colour changes (visor to green, a green wave through a crowd) render as beams and fog unless the line forbids glow, and then a crowd-wide change does not happen at all - cut between two keyframes instead. A stencilled serial spreads to neighbours by 3-4 s.
